Due to persistent signal interference, a direct flight corridor between Station Alpha and Station Beta cannot be utilized. Furthermore, owing to overlapping communication frequencies, the flight plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the corridor between Beta and Gamma, or the corridor between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop inspection circuit, where each station is visited precisely once before the drone returns to its origin, thereby minimizing the total flight distance.
